name: Kelpie
description: Reports sessions, tool calls and token usage to Kelpie's spool, and enforces Kelpie's stops.

commands.description: Record a redacted command prefix for exec calls (default true)

maxBytes.description: Spool size that moves it to <spool>.1 (default 20 MiB)

stopDir.description: Where Kelpie writes stop markers; must match [adapters.openclaw] stop_dir (default ~/.openclaw/kelpie/stop)
